content.short: Onmeta provides on- and off-ramp solutions for emerging markets like India and SEA.
content.description: When you engage with a Web3 platform, you may need to acquire the platform’s related token using fiat currency. Onmeta provides a fiat-onramp that purchases that token through a streamlined, beginner‑friendly experience designed for users who are new to crypto. Web3 platforms can integrate Onmeta to offer a smooth onboarding path, guiding users from traditional money into on‑chain activity without requiring technical steps. Retail users can buy any token supported by Onmeta, simplifying participation across ecosystems and enabling easier access to decentralized apps.
